extracted.intended_audience: registrants (public companies) and their legal/accounting/compliance teams preparing SEC filings for asset pools and oil & gas disclosures
extracted.subtask_short: SEC Reg S-K asset & oil-gas disclosures
extracted.subtask_description: Regulation S‑K disclosure requirements for asset-level data in securitizations (Schedule AL) and industry-specific oil and gas reserves/production disclosures (Items 1201–1204). Specifies exact data fields, aggregation rules, optional disclosures, and required supporting documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset number type
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the source of the asset number used to specifically identify each asset in the pool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The asset number must reference a single asset within the pool and should be the same number used for all reports required under Sections 13 or 15(d) of the Exchange Act. If an asset is removed and replaced, the new asset should receive a unique asset number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset number
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the unique ID number of the asset (or standard industry identifier for debt securities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a standard industry identifier is not assigned, provide a unique ID number. Asset number must identify a single asset and remain consistent across required reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period begin date
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the beginning date of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period end date
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the ending date of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originator
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the name of the entity that originated the loan/lease/security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Origination date
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the date the loan/lease/security was originated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquisition cost / Original security amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the original acquisition cost of the lease or the original security amount at issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For receivables added to revolving asset master trusts, provide the issuance date and amount of the receivable added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original term / Original lease term / Original security term
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the original term in months (loan/lease) or initial number of months between issuance and maturity (security).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For amortizing securities, also provide original amortization term (months to retirement if paid monthly).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduled termination date / Security maturity date
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the month and year in which the final payment is scheduled (lease termination or security maturity).

rubrics_metrics.name: Original first payment date / First payment date from issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the date of the first scheduled payment after origination/issuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Underwriting indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the loan/lease/security met the criteria for the applicable underwriting or credit-granting criteria used to originate the asset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to loans, leases, and securities to indicate first-level solicitation/credit-granting criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grace period
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the number of months during the term when no payments are due (leases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment type / Payment frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code indicating payment frequency of the loan/lease/security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subvented / Subsidy indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether a form of subsidy (e.g., cash incentives, favorable financing) is received on the lease.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle manufacturer
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the name of the manufacturer of the vehicle (loaned or leased vehicle).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle model
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the name of the model of the vehicle (loaned or leased vehicle).

rubrics_metrics.name: New or used
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the vehicle financed or leased is new or used at origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model year
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the model year of the vehicle (loaned or leased).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle type
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code describing the vehicle type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle value
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the value of the vehicle at the time of origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source of vehicle value
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code that describes the source of the vehicle value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Base residual value (leases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the securitized residual value of the leased vehicle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source of base residual value (leases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code that describes the source of the base residual value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contractual residual value (leases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the residual value stated in the contract that the lessee would need to pay to purchase the vehicle at lease end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligor/Lessee credit score type
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the type of standardized credit score used to evaluate the obligor/lessee during origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligor/Lessee credit score
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the standardized credit score of the obligor/lessee used to evaluate credit at origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligor/Lessee income verification level
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code describing the extent to which income was verified during origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligor/Lessee employment verification
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code describing the extent to which employment was verified during origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Co-obligor / co-lessee present indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether a co-obligor or co-lessee is present on the loan/lease.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment-to-income ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the scheduled monthly payment as a percentage of total monthly income of the obligor and any other obligor/co-obligor at origination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the methodology for determining monthly income in the prospectus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic location of obligor/lessee
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the obligor's/lessee's location by providing current U.S. state or territory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset added indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the asset was added to the asset pool during the reporting period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A response is required only when assets are added after the final prospectus under §230.424 is filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remaining term to maturity
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the number of months from the end of the reporting period to the loan/lease/security maturity date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modification indicator—reporting period
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the asset was modified from its original terms during the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicing advance method
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code that indicates a servicer's responsibility for advancing principal or interest on delinquent loans/leases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period beginning loan/asset balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the outstanding principal balance of the loan/underlying security/lease as of the beginning of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period beginning scheduled asset balance (securities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the scheduled principal balance of the underlying security as of the beginning of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Next reporting period payment amount due
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the total payment due to be collected in the next reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period interest rate / original interest rate / next interest rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the current interest rate in effect during the reporting period, the original interest rate at issuance, and the interest rate that will be in effect for the next reporting period (if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicing fee—percentage
rubrics_metrics.description: If the servicing fee is based on a percentage, provide the percentage used to calculate the aggregate servicing fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicing fee—flat-fee
rubrics_metrics.description: If the servicing fee is based on a flat fee, indicate the monthly servicing fee amount paid to all servicers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other loan/lease/security-level servicing fees retained by servicer
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the amount of all other fees earned by loan/lease/security administrators that reduce funds remitted (e.g., subservicing, master servicing, trustee fees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other assessed but uncollected servicer fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative amount of late charges and other fees assessed by servicer but not paid by obligor/lessee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduled interest amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the interest payment amount that was scheduled to be collected during the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduled principal amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the principal payment amount that was scheduled to be collected during the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other principal adjustments
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate any amounts that caused the principal balance to decrease or increase during the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period ending actual balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the actual balance of the loan/lease/security as of the end of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period scheduled payment amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the total payment amount that was scheduled to be collected during the reporting period (including all fees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total actual amount paid
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the total payment paid to the servicer during the reporting period (loan) or total lease payment received (lease) or total payment paid to servicer (security).

rubrics_metrics.name: Actual interest collected
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the gross amount of interest collected during the reporting period, whether or not from the obligor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actual principal collected
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the amount of principal collected during the reporting period, whether or not from the obligor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actual other amounts collected
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate total of any amounts, other than principal and interest, collected during the reporting period, whether or not from the obligor/lessee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer advanced amount
rubrics_metrics.description: If amounts were advanced by the servicer during the reporting period, specify the amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paid-through / Interest paid through date
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the date through which interest or scheduled payments are paid with payments received during the reporting period, used to calculate next payment application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zero balance indicator and details
rubrics_metrics.description: If the balance was reduced to zero during the reporting period, provide zero balance effective date and zero balance code indicating reason for reduction to zero.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current delinquency status / Number of days payment is past due / Number of payments past due
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the number of days the obligor is delinquent past payment due date (or number of payments past due) as determined by governing transaction agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset subject to demand indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the asset was the subject of a demand to repurchase or replace for breach of representations and warranties (including investor demands upon a trustee) during the reporting period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, provide status code, repurchase amount, demand resolution date, repurchaser, and repurchase/replacement reason code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status of asset subject to demand
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code that describes the status of repurchase/replacement demand as of the end of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repurchase amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the amount paid to repurchase the loan/lease/underlying security from the pool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demand resolution date
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the date the repurchase or replacement demand was resolved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repurchaser
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the name of the entity that repurchased the asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repurchase or replacement reason
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code that describes the reason for the repurchase or replacement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charged-off principal amount / Charge-off amounts
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan/lease/security has been charged off, specify the amount of uncollected principal charged off.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amounts recovered after charge-off
rubrics_metrics.description: If amounts were recovered after charge-off, specify amounts received.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modification type and payment/term extension
rubrics_metrics.description: If the asset was modified, indicate the code describing the reason for modification and provide number of months extended (payment extension/lease extension).

rubrics_metrics.name: Repossession indicator and proceeds
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the vehicle has been repossessed; if yes, provide repossession proceeds (net of repossession fees and expenses).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information specific to debt securities—Issuer and identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide issuer name, original issuance date, original security amount, title, denomination, currency, trustee name, underlying SEC file number, and underlying CIK number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt security accrual type and interest rate type
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the code describing the method used to calculate interest (accrual type) and indicate whether interest rate is fixed, adjustable, step or other.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original interest-only term (securities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate number of months from issuance during which obligor is permitted to pay only interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Callable indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the security is callable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Securitization value and discount rate (leases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the reporting period securitization value (present value of remaining scheduled payments plus base residual) and the securitization value discount rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting period ending securitization value must also be provided as of end of reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary servicer / primary loan/lease servicer
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the name (or MERS organization number for securities) of the entity that serviced or will service the asset during the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most recent servicing transfer received date
rubrics_metrics.description: If servicing has been transferred, provide the effective date of the most recent servicing transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset group number (multi-collateral structures)
rubrics_metrics.description: For structures with multiple collateral groups, indicate the collateral group number in which the asset falls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction: aggregation of reserves (oil & gas)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported total reserves shall be simple arithmetic sums of all estimates for individual properties or fields within each reserves category; probabilistic methods should not be aggregated probabilistically beyond the field or property level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves categories and by-product disclosure (oil & gas)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose reserves estimated using prices and costs under existing economic conditions for product types (oil, natural gas, synthetic oil, synthetic gas, other sales products) in categories: proved developed, proved undeveloped, total proved, and optionally probable/possible developed and undeveloped.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose in aggregate and by geographic area and for each country containing 15% or more of registrant's proved reserves (oil-equivalent barrels basis).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves reporting frequency and tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose updated reserves tables as of the close of each fiscal year, in tabular format as specified (registrant may modify format for presentation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant may combine or add information, or modify table format for ease of presentation where Items call for tabular format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure when disclosing probable/possible reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: If registrant discloses probable or possible reserves, discuss the uncertainty related to such reserves estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of basis for oil-equivalent conversions
rubrics_metrics.description: If reserves are disclosed in barrels of oil equivalent, disclose the basis for such equivalency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country disclosure exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrant need not provide disclosure of reserves in a country containing 15% or more of proved reserves if that country's government prohibits disclosure (either country-wide or for particular fields).

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion of technologies and first-time or material additions
rubrics_metrics.description: If registrant has not previously disclosed reserves or is disclosing material additions, provide a general discussion of the technologies used to establish the appropriate level of certainty for reserves estimates from material properties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Particular properties need not be identified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation of reserves estimates—internal controls and qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose and describe internal controls used in reserves estimation and qualifications of technical person primarily responsible for overseeing preparation of reserves estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a third party conducted a reserves audit, disclose the qualifications of the technical person overseeing the audit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party reserves report disclosure requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If a third party prepared or audited reserves estimates or valuation or conducted a process review and registrant represents that fact, file the third-party report as an exhibit and include specified contents where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required contents include purpose, effective/completion dates, proportion of reserves covered and geographic area, assumptions/data/methods/procedures used (including percent of reserves reviewed), discussion of primary economic assumptions, effects of regulation, inherent uncertainties, statement that all necessary methods/procedures were used, summary of conclusions, and the third party's signature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of reserves audit
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserves audit means reviewing facts/assumptions underlying a reserves estimate prepared by another party and rendering an opinion about appropriateness of methodologies, data adequacy/quality, depth/thoroughness of estimation process, classification of reserves, and reasonableness of estimated quantities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional reserves sensitivity analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrant may (but is not required to) provide a table showing sensitivity of reserves to prices by principal product and price scenario, and may disclose reserves estimates based on different price and cost criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If provided, disclose price and cost schedules and assumptions on which disclosed values are based.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proved undeveloped reserves disclosure (Item 1203)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose total quantity of proved undeveloped reserves at year end; disclose material changes in proved undeveloped reserves during the year and discuss investments and progress (including capital expenditures) to convert proved undeveloped to proved developed; explain reasons why material amounts remain undeveloped for five years or more after disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Production, prices and production costs disclosure (Item 1204)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each of last three fiscal years disclose production by final product sold (oil, gas, other products), by geographical area and for each country/field containing 15% or more of registrant's total proved reserves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also disclose average sales price per unit (including transfers) and average production cost per unit (excluding ad valorem and severance taxes) by geographical area for each of the last three years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net production definition guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Generally, net production should include only production owned by registrant and produced to its interest, less royalties and production due others; in special situations (e.g., foreign production) net before royalty may be provided if more appropriate, with a note about change from net production usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas production guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Production of natural gas should include only marketable production on an 'as sold' basis; include dry, residue, and wet gas depending on whether liquids have been extracted before transfer of title. Omit flared, injected, and gas consumed in operations. Recovered gas-lift and reproduced gas should not be included until sold.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resecuritization asset-level information requirement (Item 6)
rubrics_metrics.description: If asset pool includes asset-backed securities, provide the asset-level information specified for debt securities in Item 5 for each security in the asset pool; for asset-backed securities issued after Nov 23, 2016, provide asset-level information specified in §229.1111(h) for the assets backing each security.
